docs/ui/navigation.md has the Error screen row and section covering triggers, A-1, text, Return Home and Resume. But its last sentence states 'An error during hand 1 leaves a 0-hand session, which is not offered for Resume.' Observed in both browsers: after an error during hand 1 and Return Home, Home shows 'Resume session — Cash · 6 players · $4/$8 · 0 hands · paused' (session record handsPlayed 0, no hand records). The same happens on main's existing path (reload during hand 1 -> '0 hands · paused', Resume deals Hand #1), so 0-hand sessions are only discarded when a session is ended, not when it is left paused.
items.expected: The doc describes what the app does after an error in hand 1.
items.actual: The doc says no Resume is offered; the app offers Resume with '0 hands · paused' and Resume deals Hand #1.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: docs/ui/navigation.md describes Resume after an error in hand 1 as the app behaves. Actual: the doc says a hand-1 error leaves no Resume entry, but Home shows 'Resume session ... 0 hands · paused' after Return Home from an error during hand 1, and Resume deals Hand #1 again (the same as closing the app during hand 1 today). The 0-hand discard only happens when a session is ended.
findings.fix: Correct the hand-1 sentence in the Error screen section of docs/ui/navigation.md (and the matching statements in spec §5 'Error during hand 1' and §7) to say the paused 0-hand session is offered as '0 hands · paused' and Resume deals hand 1 again, as after closing the app during hand 1. No product change.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Not a defect in this change: leaving the table during hand 2 stores hand 2 as a forced fold, so the report-mount flow ends with 2 hand records (pre-existing Leave table behaviour), and the task Notes' premise that E10-S01 discards 0-hand sessions on an error in hand 1 is wrong for paused sessions.
findings.fix: Consider a backlog follow-up deciding whether a paused 0-hand session should be offered for Resume at all.

summary: Product behaviour is correct in both browsers: errors in React, in bot replies, in the worker, in the report mount and outside React all show the detail-free error screen once; Return Home keeps exactly the completed hands and session record, clears the dead Table history entry, spawns one fresh worker after a worker failure (hints work again), and a second error is shown again. Suites green (npm test 1405/0, e2e 350/0, lint, typecheck), no tampering. One blocking item: SPEC-13's doc states that an error in hand 1 leaves no Resume, but the app offers a '0 hands · paused' Resume (pre-existing behaviour); the doc sentence (and the spec premise) must be corrected.
